_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Philip H. Wicksteed (1844-1927). Dante's Paradiso (Temple Classics 1899, Italian facing English) and the Convivio (1903). PD. His Purgatorio and Inferno in the Temple series are by Okey and Carlyle-Okey, not him. Added 2026-10-03 by lane C (round 7) under the coordinator's standing instruction; Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst.

wicksteed-paradiso-1900: The Paradiso of Dante Alighieri (Temple Classics, Dent 1900)

wicksteed-paradiso.scan_edition: Dent 1900 reprint of the 1899 Temple Classics (Toronto copy), raw OCR with the Italian interleaved

wicksteed-convivio.scan_edition: Dent 1903 first edition (Getty copy), raw OCR

_pending.wicksteed-latin-works: The Latin Works of Dante (Temple Classics 1904): Wicksteed did the letters and eclogues, A. G. Ferrers Howell the rest; translator per piece needed. Not fetched.

_excluded.six-sermons: Dante: Six Sermons (PG 36479): Wicksteed's own work.

_name_words_note: Translator name(s) only: fetch_shelf.py treats these as the identity check (one must appear in the fetched text), so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.

wicksteed-convivio-1903.post_1930_examined: Examined: 'Digitized by the Internet Archive in 2014', a scanning credit on a merged OCR line. Imprint: Dent 1903.

_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded).
